updates.label: Daniel Sroka authorizes publication of private interview audio
updates.description: On October 14, 2026, Daniel Sroka gave permission for this site to publish audio of a private interview between Sroka, Mayor Bradley Frost, and Chief Cameron Paul.

$override.description: Rob Shelton reports on the federal lawsuit filed October 14 by Sheldon Norcross, Tyler Shaw, Sierra Lauts, and Steven Allen against American Fork City and 13 officers. The complaint alleges constitutional violations; these allegations have not been adjudicated. Ben Schneider is not a plaintiff.
